strands.provenance: Retained manufacturer end-loop views show this visible strand disappearing at an end outlet. Its shallow native well is a display estimate; the hidden connection to the rear slot or paired outlet is not asserted. Length and radius are display estimates; route and settled height come from native CAD collision solving. Section planes use an audited display tilt of ±atan(0.15) so the two visible leads remain on distinct exterior bearings; terminals remain at the actual native mouth centers.
